@type.description: Always `PropertyValue`, where `propertyID` names the scheme and `value` carries the code. This is the mechanism that makes the model work internationally: no national identifier system is privileged, and an entity may carry as many as it has. The same pattern is used by OCDS for organization identifiers.

propertyID.description: The identifier scheme. Use a registered token below, an 'org-id:<prefix>' token from the org-id.guide register, 'local:<scheme>' for a publisher's own internal register (distinct from org-id: so that provenance is never overstated), or an absolute IRI.

value.description: The identifier's actual code or value.
